alate: The head is reddish brown; the pronotum, abdominal tergites, antennae and wings are all yellowish brown; the postclypeus, the base of the mandibles and the ventral surface of the abdomen are dull yellow; the whole body is densely covered with hairs.
biology: This species builds earthen mounds; both the height and the diameter of the nest may exceed 2 m, and the nest contains many separate fungus-garden chambers; the royal cell lies roughly level with the ground surface, and the same royal cell may contain two or three queens.
distribution: Yunjinghong (500 m a.s.l.), Menghai in Banna, Simao, Mojiang (1,400 m a.s.l.), Pu'er (1,350 m a.s.l.), Hekou (90 m a.s.l.), Mengla in Jinping (370 m a.s.l.), Yingjiang, Manyun, Mangshi, Lianshan, Tengchong and Nujiangba, Yunnan.
soldier: The inner margins of the mandibles bear weak teeth; the labrum is lingulate, its lateral margins sharply incised inwards at the anterior end to form a large flexure, so that the labral apex forms a forward-projecting portion; a row of long setae is arranged along the labral margin, and the labral tip extends beyond the mandibular teeth. Antennae with 17 segments, segment 2 longer than segment 3, the tip of the terminal segment narrow. The pronotum is distinctly narrower than the head, raised in the anterior middle, and both the anterior and the posterior margin have a median notch.
worker: Body colour pale. Head nearly circular, antennae with 18 segments, segment 2 slightly longer than segment 3, pronotum saddle-shaped.
